messages:
Maria Chen: Follow-up from today's outage: we need to finalize public language, who owns customer packets, and make sure every postmortem action has an owner + due date.
Dan (SRE): Agreed. I'll lead the internal RCA and put mitigation tickets in JIRA. Draft RCA in 48h, final in 5 days.
Leo (Support): Support is getting lots of DMs. Can we get a 2-3 sentence FAQ + canned replies for urgent customers? Preferably within 24h.
Priya (Legal): Public wording should avoid speculative root cause. We can confirm impact, restoration, and that no data was exposed. For anything beyond that we should route customers to Support under NDA/contract channels.
Kai (Product): For the status page line, keep it short and action-focused. Suggest we promise a "detailed follow-up" with an ETA.
Maria Chen: Proposal for ownership: Maria will approve status page copy, Leo owns canned replies, Priya reviews legal language, Dan owns internal RCA + tickets, Kai tracks prioritization for any product work. Timeline: status copy + canned replies in 24h; RCA draft in 48h; ticketized action items in 72h.
Dan (SRE): Noted. Also: ops, please add any prior incidents with autoscaling/concurrency faults to the appendix. I want recurrence evidence before we decide on a big change.
Leo (Support): I'll build canned replies once Maria posts the approved summary. Will include suggested escalation phrasing.
Maria Chen: Draft status page copy (Kai, feel free to edit):
```
Service disruption: Text generation experienced degraded performance from 09:12 to 09:54 UTC. Service restored. No customer data exposed. A detailed follow-up will be published within 72 hours.
```
Priya (Legal): That copy is fine. Recommend we avoid the phrase "root cause" in the public blurb; use "investigating" instead.
Kai (Product): Minor tweak: replace 'detailed follow-up' with 'detailed update' — clearer for customers.
Maria Chen: Final status copy (to be posted once Leo confirms canned replies ready):
"Service disruption: Text generation experienced degraded performance from 09:12 to 09:54 UTC. Service restored. No customer data exposed. We are investigating and will post a detailed update within 72 hours."
IncidentBot: Incident #2026-118 transitioned to RESOLVED by oncall deploy.
Dan (SRE): I'm pulling SLO metrics (p95, error rates) and will attach to the RCA. Also creating a recurring-incident tag on related tickets.
Leo (Support): Scheduling a 30-min sync for tomorrow 11:00 UTC to align on messaging and handoffs. Invites sent.
Maria Chen: Action items summary:
- MARIA: approve + publish status page copy after Leo confirms replies (due 24h).
- LEO: canned replies & customer FAQ (due 24h).
- DAN: internal RCA draft + ticketize actions (draft 48h, tickets 72h).
- PRIYA: legal review of customer packet (24h).
- KAI: assess product prioritization if recurrence confirmed (edge-case).
Keep updates here so Support and SRE can reference one thread. Please add JIRA links to the ticketized actions when created. :spiral_calendar:
Maria Chen: Thanks team — let's keep momentum and meet tomorrow.
